name: restricted-artifact-not-in-prompt
invariant: A restricted artifact never reaches a prompt: a review's context of a walk's result renders the receipt and diagnostic trace and omits as restricted the remote stderr and a blob the receipt does not name (empty/completed_clean each; a restricted ref rendered is failed/restriction_dropped). Delivered later as a tool result, the stderr is refused (failed/restriction_dropped) and the trace delivered (empty/completed_clean) (12 "Content"; 10; 15 E3).
